title: Show visible and total note count
goal: Show a note count summary on the note list screen so the user can see how many notes are currently visible and how many notes exist in total.
acceptance_criteria: The note list screen shows a visible count summary near the search/list area.
The count summary shows both the number of currently visible notes and the total number of loaded notes.
When the user searches and the list is filtered, the visible count updates while the total count stays unchanged.
When the user clears the search query, the visible count returns to the total count.
The count summary has a stable data-prototype-id anchor linked to the note count summary UI element.
Existing create, edit, delete, and confirm-delete behavior remains valid.
constraints: Prefer a distinct reusable UI widget if the architecture contract supports a widget artifact.
notes: This slice intentionally checks that the planner can introduce a new UI widget artifact and wire it into an existing screen.
The requirements stage does not prescribe the widget file name; the planner owns artifact and path decisions.
